Mio's secret.summary: Mio borrowed 450,000 yen through Nightshade Exchange for the amplifier rig that faked her entrance exam result; 720,000 yen with interest by Day 60.
Mio's secret.sources: arc-bible.md sections 2 and 6; cast.json hidden (Mio Tachibana)

steps.reveal: She is hiding money trouble.
It is a debt to a criminal lender.
Nightshade Exchange is the lender.
The amplifier rig and the exam fraud: the debt paid for the rig that faked her entrance exam result.
steps.milestone_gate: The mid-semester incident (collectors hit the house, about Day 63) or Mio's confession

Sunny's scandal video.summary: The scandal video that got Sunny moved from 1A to 2B, and Ayame's part in what it shows.
Sunny's scandal video.sources: arc-bible.md sections 2 and 8 (Off-Camera); cast.json hidden (Park Seo-yeon, Ayame Kujō)

steps.reveal: Sunny deflects any mention of the video; there is more to it than the public version.
The video was cut from a longer clip; the unedited footage exists (a media archive, or a recording at Power Practice Studio).
The accident was caused by Ayame's Edge Current; Sunny took the blame on camera to shield her.

Shin's old gang.summary: Shin's juvenile record as a gang lookout and the Nine Corners, who plan to call him back.
Shin's old gang.sources: arc-bible.md section 8 (Old Corners); cast.json hidden (Shin Asakura)

steps.reveal: Shin has a juvenile record as a gang lookout.
His old gang, the Nine Corners, has contacted him and is calling him back.
The Nine Corners want him as a lookout for one night, meeting at Kurokawa District/backstreet-crossroads.

Shimazu and the Annex Cohort.summary: The experimental cohort dissolved three years ago, Yūto's history, and why Shimazu distrusts experiments like 2B.
Shimazu and the Annex Cohort.sources: arc-bible.md sections 1 and 2; cast.json hidden (Reiko Shimazu, Yūto Fujisawa)

steps.reveal: Something unspoken sits between Shimazu and Yūto; her distrust of 2B is personal, not only by the book.
An experimental off-campus cohort, the Annex Cohort, was dissolved three years ago after an injury.
Yūto is a survivor of the Annex Cohort; he never asked for it to be remembered.
Shimazu signed the Annex Cohort's dissolution; her distrust of experiments comes from that.

Arimura's broadcast failure.summary: Why Arimura teaches 2B: a rescue that failed on live broadcast, and the assignment Shimazu gave him expecting 2B to fail.
Arimura's broadcast failure.sources: arc-bible.md sections 2 and 6 (Arimura's fixed turning point); cast.json hidden and hook (Kenji Arimura)

steps.reveal: He was demoted after a rescue failed on live broadcast.
He treats the 2B post as exile and wants to get back on live air.
Shimazu assigned him to 2B expecting it to fail, and he knows it; he says so in front of her.
steps.milestone_gate: Arimura's turning point (collectors attack the house, or the fallback house-level incident in front of Shimazu, Day 70 at the latest)

Ayame's guilt.summary: Ayame's side of the scandal: what she did, what she owes Sunny, and whether she owns it.
Ayame's guilt.sources: arc-bible.md sections 2, 7 (Ayame's beat) and 8 (Off-Camera); cast.json hidden (Ayame Kujō)

steps.reveal: Ayame avoids Sunny and bristles at any mention of the scandal.
At a 1A showcase her Edge Current slipped and cut the rigging; the stage lights fell and a first-year was hurt.
Sunny said "it was me" on camera to shield her; Ayame never thanked her and avoids her out of guilt.
Ayame owns it: she admits her part, to Sunny in private or in front of others.
steps.milestone_gate: The Off-Camera conversation between Sunny and Ayame, or the Battle Test (Ayame's beat)
